J&J's gross profit rose about 14.2% from fiscal Q1 2025 to fiscal Q4 2025. The figures come from J&J's Q1 and Q4 2025 earnings releases.

- **Q1 2025:** Sales to customers were $21,893M and cost of products sold was $7,357M, so gross profit was $14,536M.
- **Q4 2025:** Gross profit was $16,596M. That equals sales of $24,564M less cost of products sold of $7,968M.

The change is (16,596 − 14,536) / 14,536, which is about +14.17%.
